releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 新增全局虚拟环境配置，全局模式优先于单个应用配置，并自动排除系统应用以保障设备稳定。
- 路线模拟悬浮窗在全局模式下直接使用全局环境，不再要求选择目标应用。
- 标题栏新增已授权/未授权状态入口，可完成授权并查看按手机时区显示的授权到期时间。
- 修复 Android 13 开启全局模式后重启可能导致系统异常的问题。
- 修复 Android 16 全局 Wi-Fi 与授权配置传递不稳定的问题。
releaseNotes.en:
- Added global virtual-environment configuration. Global mode takes priority over per-app policies and excludes system apps to protect device stability.
- The route overlay now uses the global environment directly in global mode without requiring an app selection.
- Added an authorized/unauthorized status entry in the title bar for activation and authorization details, with expiry shown in the phone's time zone.
- Fixed a potential system failure after rebooting Android 13 with global mode enabled.
- Fixed unstable global Wi-Fi and authorization policy delivery on Android 16.
